Eleven comments

The Whistling Postman

There are other tunes by this name, but this one fits the title well…a rambling high-noted airy reel, sure to catch every dog’s attention.

J. Neill, let me know if this is the one you were looking for. I learned this off a bootleg session tape of an accordion player leading the charge. Not too fast, lots of bounce.

↳ Posted by Will Harmon on March 12th, 2002.

John Carty’s version

On his Shanachie CD Last Night’s Fun John Carty plays a pleasing setting in the key of A. Carty is a master of the rare art of subtly varying a tune without losing its essential character.

↳ Posted by Layers on September 16th, 2004.
